offline.caption: On device · 3 pending
offline.title: Works without internet
offline.body: Expenses are saved on your device first and sync with your group on their own once you are back online.

encryption.caption: 256-bit · Key on device
encryption.title: End-to-end encrypted
encryption.body: Data can only be opened on group members’ devices. Nobody, not even the server, can read it.

receipt.caption: Amount · Date · Store
receipt.title: Scan the receipt, done
receipt.body: Point the camera at the receipt; amount, date and store name fill themselves in.

profile.title: Create your profile
profile.body: Only visible to people in your groups. No email or phone number needed.
profile.photoPermission: Allow access to add a photo.
profile.nameTooLong: Name can be at most 40 characters.

groups.title: Groups
groups.emptyBody: Open your first shared kitty with roommates, travel buddies or your partner.

groupForm.info: The group is stored on this device. Add members by name now, or later from the group.
groupForm.nameTooLong: Group name can be at most 40 characters.
groupForm.memberDuplicate: A member with this name already exists.
groupForm.memberTooLong: Name can be at most 40 characters.
groupForm.tooManyMembers: A group can have at most 50 people.
groupForm.onlyYou: For now it is just you.

groupDetail.subtitle: {{type}} · {{count}} people
groupDetail.owedToYou: The group owes you {{amount}} in total.
groupDetail.youOwe: You owe the group {{amount}} in total.
groupDetail.emptyBody: Add the first expense; splits and balances are calculated automatically.
groupDetail.removed: You were removed from this group. This is how it looked when you left; you won't see new changes.

expenseForm.receiptPermission: Please grant permission to attach a receipt.

balances.allSettled: Everyone is settled. No payments to suggest.
balances.footnote: “Paid” records a payment and updates balances right away. You can undo it if you tap it by mistake.

settings.localProfile: Your profile stays on this device
settings.exportHint: All expenses and payments in one file
settings.exportUnavailable: Sharing is not available on this device.
settings.deleteAllHint: Profile, groups and receipts are removed for good
settings.deleteAllBody: Your profile, every group, expense and receipt photo will be permanently removed from this device. This cannot be undone.
settings.lockUnavailableBody: Face ID or fingerprint is not set up on this device. Add it in the device settings first.
settings.lockEnablePrompt: Confirm it's you to turn on the app lock
settings.lockDisablePrompt: Confirm it's you to turn off the app lock

offlineBanner.message: Offline · changes are saved on this device

stats.emptyBody: As you add expenses, the breakdown and monthly chart show up here.

invite.title: Invite to the group
invite.body: The code carries the group's encryption key: anyone who scans it joins the group and sees every expense. Only show it to people you trust.

join.invalid: This is not an invite link.
join.waitingBody: The group is coming from the sync server. Make sure you are online.
join.whoTitle: Who are you in this group?
join.whoBody: Pick your name if it is listed, otherwise join as a new member.
join.expiredBody: The group's encryption key was replaced after this invite was made. Ask a member for a new one.

conflict.title: This expense was changed on two devices
conflict.body: Choose which one stays; your choice applies to everyone in the group.
conflict.banner: Changed on another device at the same time.

recovery.title: Keep your 12 words
recovery.body: If you lose your phone, these words are the only way to restore your data. Nobody else knows them, not even us.
recovery.warning: Don't take a screenshot or save them to the cloud. Write them on paper and keep it somewhere safe.
recovery.written: I wrote the words down somewhere safe
recovery.revealPrompt: Confirm it's you to see your recovery words
recovery.verifyTitle: Let's make sure you wrote them down
recovery.verifyBody: Pick the word at each position.

restore.title: Enter your recovery phrase
restore.body: Type your 12 words in order, separated by spaces. Your profile and groups come back to this device.
restore.label: Recovery phrase
restore.hint: Your groups download encrypted from the sync server, so you need to be online.
restore.invalid: These words are not a valid recovery phrase. Check the spelling and the order.
restore.notFound: No backup was found for this phrase.
restore.unreadable: The backup could not be opened with this phrase.
restore.offline: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

lock.title: Ortak Kasa is locked
lock.prompt: Confirm it's you to open Ortak Kasa

scan.hint: Line up the invite code inside the frame
scan.notInvite: This isn't an Ortak Kasa invite
scan.permissionBody: Allow camera access to scan the invite code, or paste the link instead.
scan.noCameraBody: There's no camera available on this device. You can paste the invite link instead.

members.removeBody: The group's encryption key will be replaced, so {{name}} won't see anything added from now on. Existing invites stop working too.
members.inUseBody: This member has expenses or payments. Delete them or move them to someone else first.
members.keyNote: Removing someone replaces the group's encryption key, so they can't see later changes.
